title: AI for Social Science and Social Science of AI: A Survey

bias_targets.methodology: Reviewing studies that analyze generated stories to evaluate if female characters are disproportionately associated with family and appearance or portrayed as less powerful than male characters.
Reviewing literature that evaluates biases against disabled people in open-ended language generation.
Reviewing experiments that measure LLMs' political leanings by assessing their responses to political surveys, hypothetical voting scenarios, and alignment with ideological prompts.
Reviewing studies that test large language models on reasoning and decision-making tasks to identify the presence of human-like cognitive and reasoning biases.
